title: Electrochemical CO 2 Capture by a Quinone-Based Covalent Organic Framework

compounds.name: anthraquinone-based COF (AQCOF)
compounds.quote: we synthesized a well-known anthraquinone-based COF (AQCOF) and employed it in electrochemical CO2 capture experiments.

compounds.name: AQCOF@CNTs
compounds.quote: the composition with 7% CNTs following AQCOF synthesis (denoted hereafter as AQCOF@CNTs) with a specific surface area (SSA) of 325 m2 g−1 was selected

a typical eCC cycle (Figure 3a) recorded using AQCOF@CNTs at 100 mA g−1 in an aqueous cell exhibited a 4-fold increase in electrochemical CO2 uptake compared to ionic liquid cells (IL ∼0.2 mmol g−1 and aq. ∼0.8 mmol g−1), with the pressure curves closely following the applied voltage.

Without a voltage hold under pure CO2, the uptake showed a negligible change (Figure S19a−c), but the electrical energy consumption of the capture process was further lowered to 31 kJ mol−1 (Table S1).
